tactical_thesis: Open the lower outer lane with rear-positioned Spot, deploy Melantha later in front of him to destroy the eastern lower restraint, and withdraw her after clearance. Move Steward north so his artillery firing position no longer shares Ansel's lower barrage. Return Melantha beside Friston before armor contact. Preserve Fang, assign actual damage and containment to every previously leaked target, and avoid unnecessary Spot healing pauses during the outer officer queue. This is a complete, unsimulated current-model hypothesis; northern shared medical survival remains its critical check.
